title: The lineage of Janaka
introduction: Janaka narrates his lineage while offering his daughters as brides to Rama and Lakshmana. In doing so, he elaborates more about his brother Kushadhvaja, whose daughters are the would-be-wives of Bharata and Shatrughna. They even fix the timings for marriage.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकसप्ततितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 71st chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
एवं ब्रुवाणं जनकः प्रत्युवाच कृतांजलिः |
श्रोतुमर्हसि भद्रं ते कुलं नः परिकीर्तितम्
verses.iast:
evam bruvāṇam janakaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ |
śrotum ar.hhasi bhadram te kulam naḥ parikīrtitam
verses.translation: When sage Vashishta said that way, Janaka reverentially made palm fold and said this in reply, "oh, sage, let safeness betide you all... now, it will be apt of you all to listen to our distinguished lineage...

glosses.meaning: this way, to him who is saying - to Vashishta
Janaka, reverentially making palm-fold, in reply said
to listen, apt of you - all of you.

verses.devanagari:
प्रदाने हि मुनिश्रेष्ठ कुलं निरवशेषतः |
वक्तव्यं कुलजातेन तन्निबोध महामुने
verses.iast:
pradāne hi muni śreṣṭha kulam niravaśeṣataḥ |
vaktavyam kula jātena tan nibodha mahāmune
verses.translation: "Oh, eminent sage Vashishta, he who is born in a particular noble gens has to inform about his parentage in its entirety, especially when he offers a bride... thereby oh, great sage, let all be informed of about our lineage...

glosses.meaning: in [a particular noble] gens, born ones
without, a little, remainder [completely, in entirety]
parentage, speakable - to be informed, isn't it
thereby, let all be informed of our lineage.

verses.devanagari:
राजाभूत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः स्वेन कर्मणा |
निमिः परमधर्मात्मा सर्वसत्त्ववतां वरः
verses.iast:
rājā abhūt triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ svena karmaṇā |
nimiḥ parama dharmātmā sarva sattvavatām varaḥ
verses.translation: "Once there was an emperor Nimi, who was renowned in the triad of worlds by his own accomplishments, and who was uniquely seraphic-souled and a best one among all stalwart emperors...

glosses.meaning: in triad, of worlds, renowned one
emperor, Nimi, was there - once upon a time.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य पुत्रो मिथिर्नाम जनको मिथिपुत्रकः |
प्रथमो जनको नाम जनकादप्युदावसुः
verses.iast:
tasya putro mithiḥ nāma janako mithi putrakaḥ |
prathamo janako nāma janakāt api udāvasuḥ
verses.translation: "And his son was named as Mithi, and Janaka was Mithi's son... the first one to be designated as Janaka... and even from that Janaka it is Udaavasu who took birth...

glosses.meaning: from Janaka, even, Udaavasu - are born.

verses.devanagari:
उदावसोस्तु धर्मात्मा जातो वै नन्दिवर्धनः |
नन्दिवर्धनपुत्रस्तु सुकेतुर्नाम नामतः
verses.iast:
udāvasoḥ tu dharmātmā jāto vai nandivardhanaḥ |
nandivardhana putraḥ tu suketuḥ nāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: "From Udaavasu it is noble souled Nandivardhana took birth, and Nandivardhana's son is named as Suketu, by his name...

verses.devanagari:
सुकेतोरपि धर्मात्मा देवरातो महाबलः |
देवरातस्य राजर्षेर्बृहद्रथ इति स्मृतः
verses.iast:
suketoḥ api dharmātmā devarāto mahābalaḥ |
devarātasya rājarṣeḥ bṛhadratha iti smṛutaḥ
verses.translation: "From Suketu the highly powerful and virtue-souled Devaraata is born, and from that kingly sage Devaraata, it is Brihadratha who took birth, thus we have heard...

glosses.meaning: from Devaraata, kingly sage, Brihadratha, thus, heard - him to be his son.

verses.devanagari:
बृहद्रथस्य शूरोऽभून्महावीरः प्रतापवान् |
महावीरस्य धृतिमान् सुधृतिः सत्यविक्रमः
verses.iast:
bṛhadrathasya śūro abhūt mahāvīraḥ pratāpavān |
mahāvīrasya dhṛtimān sudhṛtiḥ satya vikramaḥ
verses.translation: "From Brihadratha it is the highly braving, courageous and valiant Mahaaviira has come, and the bold and truth-valiant Sudhriti from Mahaaviira...

glosses.meaning: valiant one, highly brave, courageous one, Mahaaviira, became - took birth

verses.devanagari:
सुधृतेरपि धर्मात्मा धृष्टकेतुः सुधार्मिकः |
धृष्टकेतोश्च राजर्षेर्हर्यश्व इति विश्रुतः
verses.iast:
sudhṛteḥ api dharmātmā dhṛṣṭaketuḥ su dhārmikaḥ |
dhṛṣṭaketoḥ ca rājarṣeḥ haryaśva iti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: "Form Sudhriti, the right-minded and highly generous Dhristaketu took birth, and from the kingly sage Dhristaketu it is highly renowned Haryashva is the son...

glosses.meaning: Haryashva, thus, renowned - son is born.

verses.devanagari:
हर्यश्वस्य मरुः पुत्रो मरोः पुत्रः प्रतीन्धकः |
प्रतीन्धकस्य धर्मात्मा राजा कीर्तिरथः सुतः
verses.iast:
haryaśvasya maruḥ putro maroḥ putraḥ pratīndhakaḥ |
pratīndhakasya dharmātmā rājā kīrtirathaḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: "Haryashva's son is Maru, and Maru's, son is Pratiindhaka, and the son of Pratiindhaka's is noble-souled king Kiirtiratha...

verses.devanagari:
पुत्रः कीर्तिरथस्यापि देवमीढ इति स्मृतः |
देवमीढस्य विबुधो विबुधस्य महीध्रकः
verses.iast:
putraḥ kīrtirathasya api devamīḍha iti smṛtaḥ |
devamīḍhasya vibudho vibudhasya mahīdhrakaḥ
verses.translation: "The son of Kiirtiratha is remembered as Devamiidha, and the son of Devamiidha is Vibudha, and Vibudha's son is Mahiidraka...

verses.devanagari:
महीध्रकसुतो राजा कीर्तिरातो महाबलः |
कीर्तिरातस्य राजर्षेर्महारोमा व्यजायत
verses.iast:
mahīdhraka suto rājā kīrtirāto mahābalaḥ |
kīrti rātasya rājaṛṣeḥ mahāromā vyajāyata
verses.translation: "Mahiidraka's son is the great mighty king Kiirtiraata, and the son born to sagely king Kiirtiraata is Mahaaroma...

verses.devanagari:
महारोम्णस्तु धर्मात्मा स्वर्णरोमा व्यजायत |
स्वर्णरोम्णस्तु राजर्षेर्ह्रस्वरोमा व्यजायत
verses.iast:
mahāromṇaḥ tu dharmātmā svarṇaromā vyajāyata |
svarṇaromṇaḥ tu rājarṣeḥ hrasvaromā vyajāyata
verses.translation: "From Mahaaroma it is the virtue-souled Swarnaroma, and from kingly sage Swarnaroma it is Hrasvaroma...

glosses.meaning: to kingly sage, Swarnaroma, on his part

verses.devanagari:
तस्य पुत्रद्वयं जज्ञे धर्मज्ञस्य महात्मनः |
ज्येष्ठोऽहमनुजो भ्राता मम वीरः कुशध्वजः
verses.iast:
tasya putra dvayam jajñe dharmajñasya mahātmanaḥ |
jyeṣṭho aham anujo bhrātā mama vīraḥ kuśadhvaja
verses.translation: "Two sons are born to that knower of virtue and noble souled Hrasvaroma, I am the elder, and my younger brother is this brave Kushadhvaja...

glosses.meaning: sons, a pair of, are born

verses.devanagari:
मां तु ज्येष्ठं पिता राज्ये सोऽभिषिच्य नराधिपः |
कुशध्वजं समावेश्य भारं मयि वनं गतः
verses.iast:
mām tu jyeṣṭham pitā rājye so abhiṣicya narādhipa |
kuśadhvajam samāveśya bhāram mayi vanam gataḥ
verses.translation: "He that king and father of ours, Hrasvaroma, anointing me in kingdom as I am the elder, and vesting the duty of looking after Kushadhvaja in me, he departed to forests...

verses.devanagari:
वृद्धे पितरि स्वर्याते धर्मेण धुरमावहम् |
भ्रातरं देवसंकाशं स्नेहात् पश्यन् कुशध्वजम्
verses.iast:
vṛddhe pitari svar yāte dharmeṇa dhuram āvaham |
bhrātaram deva saṅkāśam snehāt paśyan kuśadhvajam
verses.translation: "On the departure of our aged father to heaven, I am looking after this godlike Kushadhvaja with brotherliness and lugging around the burden of this kingship...

glosses.meaning: aged, father, to heaven, on departure
by friendship [with brotherliness,] while looking after

verses.devanagari:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य सांकाश्यादगमत्पुरात् |
सुधन्वा वीर्यवान् राजा मिथिलामवरोधकः
verses.iast:
kasyacit tu atha kālasya sāṅkāśyāt agamat purāt |
sudhanvā vīryavān rājā mithilām avarodhakaḥ
verses.translation: "Then after sometime, a valorous king named Sudhanva came beleaguering Mithila, from his city Saamkaasha...

verses.devanagari:
स च मे प्रेषयामास शैवं धनुरनुत्तमम् |
सीता कन्या च पद्माक्षी मह्यं वै दीयतामिति
verses.iast:
sa ca me preṣayāmāsa śaivam dhanuḥ anuttamam |
sītā kanyā ca padmākṣī mahyam vai dīyatām iti
verses.translation: " 'The unexcelled bow of Shiva shall be given to me, along with the lotus-eyed virgin, Seetha...' thus he started to urge me...

glosses.meaning: thus, he, even, me, started to urge.

verses.devanagari:
तस्याप्रदानाद्ब्रह्मर्षे युद्धमासीन्मया सह |
स हतोऽभिमुखो राजा सुधन्वा तु मया रणे
verses.iast:
tasya apradānāt brahmarṣe yuddham āsīt mayā saha |
sa hato abhimukho rājā sudhanvā tu mayā raṇe
verses.translation: "Oh, Brahma sage Vashishta, for the reason of my non-bestowal of bow or bride he warred with me, and when he affronted me in that war I have put that Sudhanva to the sword...

glosses.meaning: non, bestowal - for the reason of
he, king, Sudhanva, on his part
by me, put to the sword.

verses.devanagari:
निहत्य तं मुनिश्रेष्ठ सुधन्वानं नराधिपम् |
सांकाश्ये भ्रातरं शूरमभ्यषिंचं कुशध्वजम्
verses.iast:
nihatya tam muniśreṣṭha sudhanvānam narādhipam |
sāṅkāśye bhrātaram śūram abhyaṣiñcam kuśadhvajam
verses.translation: "Oh, best sage Vashishta, on eliminating king Sudhanva, I have anointed my valiant brother Kushadhvaja in the kingdom of Saamkaasha...

glosses.meaning: lord of people, him, Sudhanva, on eliminating

verses.devanagari:
कनीयानेष मे भ्राता अहं ज्येष्ठो महामुने |
ददामि परमप्रीतो वध्वौ ते मुनिपुंगव
सीतां रामाय भद्रं ते ऊर्मिलां लक्ष्मणाय वै |
verses.iast:
kanīyān eṣa me bhrātā aham jyeṣṭho mahāmune |
dadāmi parama prīto vadhvau te munipuṅgava
sītām rāmāya bhadram te ūrmilām lakṣmaṇāya vai |
verses.translation: "Oh, best saint Vashishta, this is that younger brother of mine, and I am the elder. Oh, eminent-saint, I am bestowing those brides with a highly gladdened heart... Seetha for Rama, and Urmila for Lakshmana, let there be felicity for all...

glosses.meaning: to you - to all, let there be felicity,.

verses.devanagari:
वीर्यशुल्कां मम सुतां सीतां सुरसुतोपमाम्
द्वितीयामूर्मिलां चैव त्रिर्वदामि न संशयः |
ददामि परमप्रीतो वध्वौ ते मुनिपुंगव
verses.iast:
vīrya śulkām mama sutām sītām sura suta upamām
dvitīyām ūrmilām caiva triḥ vadāmi na saṃśayaḥ |
dadāmi parama prīto vadhvau te munipuṅgava
verses.translation: "My daughter Seetha is the bounty for bravery and in simile she is the daughter of the divine Providence, and thus the second one Urmila too... oh, eminent-saint, with a highly gladdened heart I reiterate thrice while I bestow those brides, there is no doubt about it...
notes: The thrice reiteration is the threefold commitment mano vāk kāya karaṇāḥ i.e., 'the three instruments of communication, mind, voice, and body... so I endow the brides whole-heartedly, clear-articulately, and agleam-physically...' Here this verse is addressed to Vashishta, while other mms say that it is aimed at Dasharatha by placing words 'raghunandana' instead of 'munipungava.'

verses.devanagari:
रामलक्ष्मणयो राजन् गोदानं कारयस्व ह |
पितृकार्यं च भद्रं ते ततो वैवाहिकं कुरु
verses.iast:
rāma lakṣmaṇayo rājan go dānam kārayasva ha |
pitṛ kāryam ca bhadram te tato vaivāhikam kuru
verses.translation: "Oh, king Dasharatha, let the preceding ritual of samaavartna, be undertaken, and let manes be propitiated by the ritual, naandi shraadha, and afterwards you make happen the wedding celebrations ... thus, all will be blest...
notes: The wording go dāna differs from the ordinary lexical meaning 'cow donation' as the word gāvaka means body hair and dāna is releasing, or let-going, i.e., shaving. When the students return home after the studentship they will be admitted into household after some rituals like shaving off unnecessary hair, taking oil bath etc. gauḥ dvayoḥ tu raśmiḥ dṛg bāṇa svarja vajra ambu lomasu - nā nā - go dānam caula vat kāryam śoḍāṣe abde taducyate | In this there will be a real cow donation also to the teacher of that student, when the students sheds his hair, after the barber attends him. After shaving off the unwanted hair, then samāvartana is undertaken. The problem pointed out at this place is, that Rama or Lakshmana are born without vyanjana keśa unwanted hair, except head-hair, as Indian mytholoj~n will not give a hairy makeup to these four brothers. 'How then Janaka asked to undertake such ceremony, when discardable hair itself is not there...' is the objection. Whether they have hair or not, the ceremony has to go on.

glosses.meaning: cow, donation [lexically, but this is different and given in comment]
to manes, ritual, also [get it done]
afterwards, wedding celebrations, you make happen

verses.devanagari:
मघा ह्यद्य महाबाहो तृतीये दिवसे प्रभो |
फल्गुन्यामुत्तरे राजंस्तस्मिन् वैवाहिकं कुरु |
रामलक्ष्मणयोरर्थे दानं कार्यं सुखोदयम्
verses.iast:
maghā hi adya mahābāho tṛtīye divase prabho |
phal.hgunyām uttare rājan tasmin vaivāhikam kuru |
rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ arthe dānam kāryam sukhodayam
verses.translation: "Oh, great dextrous Dasharatha, the star ruling today is magha, isn't it... oh, lord, on the third from now, say day after tomorrow, when the star phaalguNi comes, in its later part, namely uttara phalugNi, you may make happen this wedding, and the bounties like go bhuu tila hiraNya aadi i.e., ' cows, lands, grains, gold etc., that ensue the wellbeing of Rama and Lakshmana, may be accorded to the eligible generously...
notes: These old people have meticulously calculated stars and their sidereal times for marriage, but being old, they have forgotten to print the date of wedding on wedding invitations or, at least said about it. Thereby the dating of Ramayana has become a problem, and dating with Ramayana prospered.

glosses.meaning: today, [ruling star is] Magha, isn't it
for wellbeing, invoking, for purpose of [wellbeing is the only ensuing factor]
